evidence_categories.D: Demonstrated source workflow on that lineage, restricted to its actual scope
evidence_categories.U: Unknown current feasibility or empirical benefit

evidence_rule: Categories are not ordered scores. No candidate earns implementation credit for added modules or borrowed source performance.

common_basis.team: Five ASCEND roles, possibly overlapping. Count and workload unspecified.
common_basis.profiles: Complete minimum early workflow, mandatory CPU domain and assurance modules for every candidate. Tool/model versions and case profiles to be fixed before tests.
common_basis.cases: Two contrasting predefined EPS cases. Exact cases pending agreement.
common_basis.implementation_language: Candidate native formats remain free. Textual SysML v2 is the comparison description.
common_basis.optional_fidelity: GPU scenes and robotics only for decision-specific fidelity. Geometry can be supplied by specialist models.
common_basis.hil: Later external equipment, timing and safety baseline. No mandatory hardware loop in current minimum.
common_basis.cost: Dated CAD direct-use cost over agreed period. Show existing/incremental resources and development/maintenance labor separately. No budget ceiling supplied.

gates.design_obligation: Every designated mandatory obligation has a named data, software, tool or procedure realization, owner, interface and evidence status. Preserve all concern families.
gates.implemented_evidence: Requirement-specific verdicts against the frozen scope. Unsupported checks and excluded physical outcomes remain explicit. An unspecified bridge is insufficient.
gates.status_all_candidates: Proposed concept with unresolved checks. Not verified.

gates.design_obligation: Declare one authority per field, semantic mappings, accepted revisions, dependency relationships, rejection handling and evidence invalidation.
gates.implemented_evidence: Qualified-reference tests of identities, units, sign/time/mode meanings, partial and conflicting transfers, reciprocal EPS/load changes, failed gates and stale evidence. Unresolved critical findings prevent a supported decision verdict.
gates.status_all_candidates: Proposed concept with unresolved checks. Not verified.

gates.design_obligation: Separate trace validity, model applicability, EPS acceptance and facility authorization. Define calibration, validation, uncertainty and observation-quality records.
gates.implemented_evidence: Reject unsupported analytical claims and incomplete physical proposals. Preserve invalid/inactive samples and clock uncertainty. Verify safety handoff controls without hazardous hardware tests. A simulation never authorizes a hardware fault.
gates.status_all_candidates: Proposed concept with unresolved checks. Not verified.

gates.design_obligation: Bind source, input, model, software, tool, environment, criterion and raw outputs into a retained release with recovery instructions.
gates.implemented_evidence: An independent participant reconstructs and reruns designated analyses under rules fixed beforehand. Missing licenses, mutable links or unavailable dependencies remain failures or undetermined outcomes. Reproducibility is distinct from predictive accuracy.
gates.status_all_candidates: Proposed concept with unresolved checks. Not verified.

gates.design_obligation: Identify the core and allowed parameters, extensions and mappings for both contrasting cases.
gates.implemented_evidence: Both cases complete their designated workflow without an undeclared core repair. A repair creates a new baseline and requires rerunning both cases. Report the failed trial.
gates.status_all_candidates: Proposed concept with unresolved checks. Not verified.

gates.design_obligation: Declare supported versions, legal access, accounts, compute/storage, export rights, backups and maintenance responsibility.
gates.implemented_evidence: Verify actual access and recovery on the selected deployment. Apply resource ceilings only if stakeholders later supply them. An unknown fee is not zero. Licensed access alone is not a conflict.
gates.status_all_candidates: Proposed concept with unresolved checks. Not verified.

PA-CDT:E01.claim: CSRM supplies reusable space and ground logical architecture and relationships among stakeholders, requirements, architecture, measures, and use cases. Mission teams prune, extend, or replace content.

PA-CDT:E02.claim: The mission model is maintained as a central design baseline. Component power, weight, cost, and performance can roll up. Verification activities can reference plans, procedures, results, and status.
PA-CDT:E02.maturity_and_limit: Reported modeling pattern. The paper says power, weight, and cost parametrics had not been added to CSRM, p. 6. BOM and cost automation remain proposed.

PA-CDT:E03.claim: SysML behavior called STK, MATLAB, and Java analyses through ModelCenter and MBSE Analyzer. Returned time histories supported solar area and battery capacity trades and mission requirement checks.
PA-CDT:E03.maturity_and_limit: Reported simulation proof of concept. It concentrates on energy and data, with several other subsystems simplified. It does not validate a Python or SysML v2 bridge.

PA-CDT:E04.claim: A Python parser extracts model data, requirements lists, and dependency graphs and can write analysis updates back. Its demonstrated parser is Gaphor specific.
PA-CDT:E04.maturity_and_limit: Reported software proof of concept on a theoretical academic mission. The paper identifies missing safe/off-nominal and early orbit coverage. Parser code is GPLv3.

PA-CDT:E05.claim: EPS development proceeds through mission definition, preliminary power budget, topology and component selection, and functional and environmental verification. Thermal and EMC analyses precede fabrication.
PA-CDT:E05.maturity_and_limit: Reported lifecycle method with one 3U hardware case. Useful procedure structure. It does not establish this framework's trace or reproduction services.

PA-CDT:E06.claim: A mission simulation relates attitude and communication modes to solar generation, load peaks, and battery discharge. Battery sizing considers mission cycles and depth of discharge.
PA-CDT:E06.maturity_and_limit: Reported sizing and simulation case. Its empirical aging equation, margins, topology, and thresholds require independent applicability checks. They are not generic framework constants.

PA-CDT:E07.claim: Battery protection is simulated in LTspice before experimental overcurrent and undervoltage/overvoltage checks. The equipment setup identifies power supply, electronic loads, multimeter, and oscilloscope.
PA-CDT:E07.maturity_and_limit: Reported laboratory mechanism. A simulated fault is useful for planning. It does not establish a universally safe hardware injection limit.

PA-CDT:E08.claim: The telemetry test couples STK attitude data to an OBC, records dynamic ADCS current, and checks timestamped telemetry identities, uptime, channel currents, modes, and temperatures.
PA-CDT:E08.maturity_and_limit: Reported HIL case, external to the current project scope. Sampling and mission behavior are case specific.

locations.exact_locator: `handpicked-0003`, p. 14 and Figs. 25–26 on pp. 18–19, Section 8.1.7

PA-CDT:E09.claim: Thermal vacuum results are reported through referenced work. EMC, radiation, and mechanical qualification tests were not performed and are future work. Data are confidential.
PA-CDT:E09.maturity_and_limit: Partial qualification. The conclusion's broader flight readiness wording should not conceal these explicit limits.

PA-CDT:E10.claim: Omniverse supplies a USD scene, semantic identities, units, coordinate frames, telemetry and simulation bindings, and read/write visualization APIs.
PA-CDT:E10.maturity_and_limit: Reported battery architecture and visualization. Transfer to CubeSat geometry and interfaces is proposed.

locations.exact_locator: `handpicked-0001`, pp. 3–5, Architecture Overview and Virtual 3D Environment Module

PA-CDT:E11.claim: PyBaMM electrochemical and lumped thermal models are calibrated against XJTU battery data. SOH prediction and an uncertainty proxy are evaluated. The dataset includes a satellite-use profile.
PA-CDT:E11.maturity_and_limit: Reported dataset evaluation in a 2025 preprint. It does not demonstrate a CubeSat pack, radiation effects, safe hardware control, or the full autonomous closed loop. Its errors do not transfer to this candidate.

PA-CDT:E12.claim: The presentation combines Python, OpenModelica, Kit extensions, FMI/FMU, and external solvers. Isaac examples include UUV battery consumption and energy tracking for a lunar robot.
PA-CDT:E12.maturity_and_limit: Workshop demonstration and architectural patterns. The examples are not CubeSat EPS validation.

PA-CDT:E13.claim: USD plus FMI integration is described as an MVP and open sample proof of concept. Standard and implementation work is in progress.
PA-CDT:E13.maturity_and_limit: Explicitly immature integration. FMI itself and proposed USD bindings have different maturity. Compatibility and clock behavior require checks.

PA-CDT:E14.claim: A 6U EPS model represents solar arrays, regulators, battery, PDU, and loads. Python updates inputs. A simplified one-array/one-regulator model is compared with hardware before CHIL and PHIL demonstrations. The complete model is then used for an orbit simulation.
PA-CDT:E14.maturity_and_limit: Reported laboratory correlation of a simplified EPS model on Typhoon HIL. It supports an assurance sequence, not the new implementation's real-time capability.

PA-CDT:E15.claim: The 6U model fixes battery temperature and health, simplifies switching converters and PDU loads, and omits solar and battery degradation and cell balancing.
PA-CDT:E15.maturity_and_limit: Explicit model limits. This source alone cannot justify coupled thermal or lifetime predictions. Replacing physical mission replicas remains a possibility.

PA-CDT:E16.claim: SONATE diagnosis compares expected behavior with telemetry. Calibration, tolerance intervals, state-dependent valid values, and conditional component mappings are required. Poor models produce false positives and negatives.
PA-CDT:E16.maturity_and_limit: Reported replay and manipulated qualification telemetry experiments. An apparent transceiver fault was an unmodeled external supply, pp. 25–26. Onboard use and automatic recalibration were future work.

PA-CDT:E17.claim: SysML hardware and software groupings can differ. A MagicDraw plugin exports F Prime architecture, while mission functionality and command, telemetry, event, and parameter definitions need separate work in the reported workflow.
PA-CDT:E17.maturity_and_limit: Reported architecture generation proof of concept. It does not provide a native SysML v2 generator. Current F Prime support must be checked against a pinned release.

PA-CDT:E18.claim: Software view products include command conditions and impacts, dictionaries, interface descriptions, software requirements, model cohesion, and V&V plans. F Prime typed connections and cFS publish-subscribe require different mappings.
PA-CDT:E18.maturity_and_limit: Reported framework distinctions and proposed view taxonomy. No general cross-framework code generator is validated.

PA-CDT:E19.claim: The PHI-Demo software separates EPS control, telemetry collection, FDIR, and script management. Resource checks include CPU, memory, and task traces. Processor and OS choice affect power.
PA-CDT:E19.maturity_and_limit: Reported embedded software and FlatSat case. The selected implementation is FreeRTOS based, not a validation of cFS or F Prime. Version-specific OS claims need current checking.

PA-CDT:E20.maturity_and_limit: Review synthesis and design principles. It establishes research gaps and mechanisms, not this framework's benefits.

PA-CDT:E21.claim: Physical architecture includes software, hardware, persistent data, and procedures. Node partitioning can follow organizational responsibility. Logical distribution precedes technology allocation.

protocols.protocol: Write and update EPS/component requirements from common load/thermal facts. Record active person-hours, assistance, missing fields and reviewer defects. Review technical criteria separately from schema checks.

Change a payload mode, bus constraint, component option and software definition in separate fixtures. Record elapsed time, active work, waiting, runs, exact impacts and stale/regenerated evidence. A correct outcome matches the reference and has no critical finding affecting the designated decision.

Use the same qualified models for an attitude/load shortage, protection event and policy comparison. Record supported checks, raw histories, runtime, numerical coupling and validity status. Update a battery parameter using calibration data and challenge with independent data. Report voltage/temperature/energy errors in their own units. Out-of-domain and absent thermal/EMC checks remain visible.

Generate a reviewed failure-dependency representation from the same architecture. Record preparation effort, transformation differences, coverage and unsupported rates/recovery assumptions. Do not manufacture achieved RAM.

Generate normal/fault proposals with the same DUT/equipment fixture. Technician reviews feasibility and safety. Seed time skew, gaps and inactive values. Record preparation/clarification effort, omissions, validity masks and synchronization uncertainty. No hazardous execution is needed.

Map one EPS service to pinned cFS and F-Prime profiles. Check dictionaries, guards/effects, rejection/recovery/mode ownership and compile/schema results. Record target/version/resource gaps. Target timing and power require target evidence or qualified models.

Independent user reconstructs a retained analysis in a clean environment after working data have changed. Record active effort, missing dependencies and result agreement. Reviewer locates the applicable criterion, rationale, validity limits, failure and revision using a fixed task set.

Start from a declared clean environment. Complete a correct reference workflow. Freeze the core and apply both predefined cases. Record install/training/support, active adaptation work, deviations and common-core identity.

Use dated applicable offers/invoices for licenses, seats, services, compute/storage and required support over one agreed period in CAD. Show incremental and existing resources separately. Record development/maintenance labor separately as person-hours. Record EPS BOM/project costs separately.

Use blinded seeded semantic, trace, stale-version, credibility, software and telemetry discrepancies plus clean controls. Report TP, FP, FN by family, critical misses and reviewer disagreements. Optional precision/recall/F1 are descriptive. A high average cannot compensate for a critical miss.

declared_analyst_priorities: Reuse documented requirement, architecture, engineering-value and procedure services before creating equivalent general purpose services

decision.rationale: PA-VS has the strongest combined documented service basis under the declared reuse-first priority. This is a design direction. selection_change_conditions.response: Suspend PA-VS. Compare PA-CDT and PA-GY local cores through TP-02/07/08. Do not presume either is cheaper. VS-E06/E09, VS-CHK-01/09/10.

selection_change_conditions.condition: Stable-ID, partial-update or mode-semantic tests fail, or synchronization/clean replay burden removes the native-service benefit.
selection_change_conditions.response: Reopen selection. PA-CDT is favored only if its native quantity/extraction/change and replay checks pass. PA-GY is equally admissible if its schemas/semantic rules pass. CDT K02/K05/K09, GY-V2/V4/V8.

selection_change_conditions.condition: Team priorities favor local editable semantic models and independent retained releases over native web services, with confirmed maintainer and toolchain capacity.
selection_change_conditions.response: Prefer PA-CDT's CPU core conditionally. Its CSRM completion, FMI and software-profile development remain required. GPU profiles remain optional. baseline-csrm-conversion, CDT-C1–C8, K01–K11.

selection_change_conditions.condition: Common tests show YAML authoring and the same domain modules meet all gates with better observed adoption, maintenance and direct cost.
selection_change_conditions.response: Select PA-GY under that measured preference. Expanded scope alone cannot disqualify YAML. GY-E09/E11, GY-P1–P7, GY-V1–V8.

selection_change_conditions.condition: Existing COMET/Excel access, mature exchange behavior and team skills yield better common-task results.
selection_change_conditions.response: Select PA-COM if companion semantics, safety and replay also pass. Conceptual-phase origin is not an automatic exclusion. COM-E04/E08, COM-CHK-01–08.

selection_change_conditions.condition: A maintained Nanospace/Gaphor/NSS deployment provides verified off-nominal, release and expanded domain integrations.
selection_change_conditions.response: Select PA-NS if its measured collaboration/adaptation benefit justifies stewardship and reconciliation burden. NS-E08/E11/E12, NS-V01–V11.

selection_change_conditions.condition: A case requires spatial or robotic interaction that materially affects its EPS decision.
selection_change_conditions.response: Evaluate an activated scene profile separately. PA-CDT's OpenUSD/Omniverse/Isaac/FMI path gains credit only through K12 and decision-specific validation. This condition does not retroactively improve its CPU-core ranking. CDT:E10–E13, CDT-X1–X4.

pareto_utility_framework.pareto_status: Undetermined. Candidate observations and defensible bounds are absent.
pareto_utility_framework.dominance_rule: After gates, no worse on every agreed raw measure and better on at least one. Robust uncertain dominance requires justified bounds preserving comparison.
pareto_utility_framework.formula: S(c) = sum_j w_j u_j(x_cj), for eligible candidates, w_j >= 0, sum_j w_j = 1
pareto_utility_framework.normalization: Fix purpose-based value swings and anchors before seeing results. Avoid observed-best normalization and duplicate measure counting.
pareto_utility_framework.unknown_data_rule: Unknown remains unknown. No invented distributions. Literature shares and N/D/T/P/U labels are not cardinal utilities.
